Former Delta State Governor, Dr Emmanuel Uduaghan, who died on October 19, 2026, three days before his 72nd birthday, is to be buried on Friday, December 18, 2026. This was contained in a burial programme issued by the family and signed by Chief Emmanuel Uduaghan, the Alema of Warri Kingdom, on behalf of the family. Copies of the programme were made available to journalists on Wednesday. The burial programme shows that activities will commence on December 14 with a State Valedictory Service and Tribute at The Dome Event Centre, Asaba. Other events include a Service of Songs on December 17 at First Baptist Church, Warri, and the funeral service on December 18 at Umuegbe Primary School, Abigborodo, Warri North, beginning at 11 am, followed by a private interment. NMDPRA urges stricter compliance with tanker safety standards Delta hospital denies free DNA test claims Delta motorcyclists demand justice for colleague killed at rally A Thanksgiving Service will hold on Sunday, December 20, at First Baptist Church, Warri. Uduaghan , who was governor of Delta State from 2007 to 2015, had earlier served as the state’s Commissioner for Health from 1999 to 2003 and Secretary to the Delta State Government from 2003 to 2007. Throughout his years in public service, he demonstrated a commitment to the human and infrastructural development of Delta State.
